description: REQ-006 requires collector/deadline exhaustion to terminate. withinDeadline only races the operation against a timer and never aborts or cancels the operation; after rejection, the Telegram/email/parallel work continues in the background and can keep polling providers beyond the declared hard deadline.

evidence.snippet: return await Promise.race([ operation(), new Promise((_, reject) => { timer = setTimeout(() => reject(closedFailure(code)), deadlineMs); }) ]);
